purpose: Bind the 21-operation authored reward envelope to the current Economy Admiral quest-reward valuation surface before any item reward is allowed to materialize.

economyAuthority.integrationMeaning: Economy Admiral exposes positive finite handbook-price lookup for quest-item valuation and, as of main 4a31b134, ranks separate reducible reward records by total handbook economic value with reducible value as the tie-breaker. Admiral must therefore review the whole reward package economically rather than infer value from stack count or record order.

materializationChecklist: select the exact reward TPL only after the operation objective shape is proven on SPT 4.1.3
resolve every selected TPL through Economy Admiral handbook-price authority; missing or non-positive price rejects the item reward
for weapons, armor, helmets or rigs, prove all mandatory child slots/default inserts before valuation
value every separate item reward record by handbook economic value; do not rank records by stack count or declaration order
sum direct RUB plus handbook-valued item rewards and compare the combined package to the operation risk-band ceiling
reject boss/Raider gear, rare-ammo, stim, key, container or capability-faucet rewards unless an explicit operation-specific exception survives Economy Admiral review
keep storefront/renewable unlock decisions separate from one-time reward valuation

currentWave.reason: The authored wave intentionally defaults to XP/RUB/standing. Current Economy authority is sufficient to evaluate a future exceptional item reward deterministically, but no item reward is pre-approved and runtime materialization remains disabled.

authorityRefresh.economyChangeConsumed: Economy Admiral: rank separate quest item rewards by handbook value (#318)
authorityRefresh.effectOnAdmiralRewardPlan: Stronger fail-closed valuation semantics only; no reward amount, quest, offer, standing or frozen runtime count changes.
